examples.text: “Now why do I get the feeling we're not talking about the harebrained plan you came up with?” “It wasn't harebrained.” “Did it have you going within twenty feet of a whorehouse at night, unchaperoned?” He knew darn well it did.

glosses: Frivolous and silly; featherbrained or scatterbrained; stupid.
